title: Look at the aquarium before you reach for the tools
dek: A simple observation routine for freshwater and reef keepers. The whole checklist is here—nothing to open.

items.title: Watch the animals
items.text: Look for a change from their usual activity, appearance or interest in food. Make observation part of feeding, rather than dropping food in and walking away.

items.title: Check the equipment
items.text: Look at filter output and confirm the lighting timer is following its intended schedule. A running motor is not a substitute for checking the water flow.

items.title: Read the thermometer
items.text: Compare the measured temperature with the needs of your livestock. Read the water temperature, not just the heater’s setting.

items.title: Leave a useful note
items.text: Our suggestion: jot down today’s reading, anything unusual and the last change you made. Bring that record when asking for help rather than relying on memory.

note: This is an observation checklist, not a complete maintenance or health assessment. Keep your aquarium’s species-specific testing, cleaning and water-change routine.
